title: Trial Reminders workflow: before and after the fixes
subtitle: GHL workflow aaaa1111, 2 Oct 2026

before.title: Before
items: Every Operator Base event enrolled the workflow.
One signup got the welcome SMS twice.
Add Tag sat before Create contact, so it never applied.

after.title: After
items: Add Tag runs after Create contact, so the tag applies.

verdict: Two fixes in one workflow: v6 added the If/Else, v7 moved the tag step.
